59087544.s: Al Faisaliyah Tower is one of the most prominent buildings in Riyadh. The tower includes a shopping mall of three floors plus a ground floor with 150 shops. On the south side of the project stands an eight-story serviced apartment building with one hundred furnished apartments and 99 floors.
